assistant|orlando_activity: Visit the Disney World theme parks: Magic Kingdom, Epcot, Animal Kingdom, and Hollywood Studios
Explore the Wizarding World of Harry Potter at Universal Studios and Islands of Adventure
Visit the Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex to see space exploration artifacts
Spend a day at SEA LIFE Orlando Aquarium and interact with marine life
Visit LEGOLAND Florida Resort and build with LEGOs
Explore the museums and gardens at the Maitland Art Center
Visit Gatorland to see alligators, crocodiles, and tropical birds up close
Spend a day at the Crayola Experience making art with unique art supplies
Watch an Orlando Magic basketball game at the Amway Center
Spend a day at Discovery Cove swimming with dolphins, snorkeling with fish, and relaxing on the beach
Orlando has several escape rooms offering immersive puzzle-solving experiences
Watch a Cirque du Soleil acrobatic and theatrical performance in Orlando
Take an airboat tour through the Florida Everglades to see alligators and wildlife up close
Ride the Orlando Eye, a 400-foot observation wheel with panoramic views of Orlando
Visit the Orlando Science Center with interactive exhibits and educational programs for all ages
See artwork from various periods and artists at the Orlando Museum of Art
Visit amusement parks besides Disney and Universal, such as Fun Spot America, ICON Park, and SeaWorld
See works by Louis Comfort Tiffany, including stained glass lamps, at the Charles Hosmer Morse Museum of American Art
Enjoy dance, music, and theater performances at the Dr. Phillips Center for the Performing Arts
Experience classic and contemporary works at the Orlando Shakespeare Theater
assistant|orlando_restaurant: Toothsome Chocolate Emporium & Savory Feast Kitchen at Universal CityWalk offers imaginative dishes and desserts
The Cheesecake Factory at The Mall at Millenia offers a diverse menu and extensive cheesecake selection
Shake Shack in Winter Park offers burgers, hot dogs, and shakes
Hash House A Go Go on International Drive serves 'twisted farm food'
Bahama Breeze on International Drive is a Caribbean-themed restaurant with a family-friendly atmosphere
Blaze Pizza at Disney Springs offers build-your-own Neapolitan pizzas and salads
T-Rex Cafe at Disney Springs is a dinosaur-themed restaurant with a prehistoric dining experience
Uncle Julio's in Orlando and Kissimmee serves Tex-Mex and authentic Mexican dishes
Pio Pio in the Dr. Phillips neighborhood serves Peruvian dishes
Sweet Tomatoes is a buffet chain throughout Orlando with salads, soups, and baked goods
The Cowfish Sushi Burger Bar at Universal CityWalk specializes in creative sushi and gourmet burgers
BJ's Restaurant and Brewhouse in Orlando offers American dishes and on-site brewed beers
Mediterranean Blue in Orlando serves classic Greek dishes like souvlaki and gyros
Black Bean Deli in Orlando serves Cuban sandwiches and plantains
Dandelion Communitea Cafe in Orlando is a vegetarian and vegan restaurant with salads, sandwiches, and smoothies
The Whiskey in Orlando has a family-friendly outdoor seating area and American dishes with a Southern twist
Kobe Japanese Steakhouse in Orlando is a hibachi grill offering an entertaining dining experience
Soco Restaurant in Thornton Park offers Southern-style dishes with a modern twist and a weekend brunch
assistant|orlando_dessert_spot: The Sugar Factory at Icon Park offers sweet treats, specialty drinks, and giant milkshakes
Wondermade in Sanford, just north of Orlando, offers unique flavored marshmallows and s'mores kits
Gideon's Bakehouse at Disney Springs offers cookies, cakes, and other baked treats
Kelly's Homemade Ice Cream in Orlando offers small-batch flavors like Banana Cream Pie and Strawberry Jalapeno
Voodoo Doughnut at Universal CityWalk offers imaginative doughnuts with unique toppings and flavors
The Glass Knife in Winter Park serves cakes, pastries, and sweet treats in a stylish setting
Lickety Splitz in Orlando serves handmade frozen yogurt, sorbet, and ice cream
Better Than Sex in Ivanhoe Village specializes in decadent desserts like chocolate fondue and cheesecake
The Greenery Creamery in Thornton Park offers all-natural ice cream flavors like lavender, honeycomb, and matcha
The Pastry Studio in Daytona Beach, just east of Orlando, offers custom cakes and desserts
assistant|dessert_crawl_advice: Assistant advises against visiting all dessert spots in one night and recommends picking one or two to savor
assistant|dessert_crawl_tip: Create an itinerary mapping out dessert spot locations and the best route, factoring in traffic and parking
Share desserts with family members so everyone can try a variety of treats
Order desserts to-go and eat them on the go when there is no time to sit down
Visit dessert spots during non-peak times to avoid long lines
Drink water throughout the night to stay hydrated during the dessert crawl
Wear comfortable shoes since the dessert crawl involves a lot of walking
Consider renting a bike, taking a rideshare, or calling a taxi when moving between dessert spots
